execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."AnalysisResult" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "importantDates" text,
  "keyTopics" text,
  "summary" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Checklist" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ChecklistItem" (
  "checklistId" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isCompleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DetectedClause" (
  "analysisId" text NOT NULL,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "explanation" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "importance" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "originalText" text NOT NULL,
  "questions" text,
  "whyItMatters" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Document" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "pageCount" int4,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "uploadUrl" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DocumentAnnotation" (
  "content" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DocumentChunk" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "pageNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  "versionId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DocumentEmbedding" (
  "chunkId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "model" text NOT NULL,
  "vector" vector(1536) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DocumentVersion" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "fileUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "versionNum" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Question" (
  "answer" text,
  "citations" text,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Session" (
  "expires" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
